privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GestandoApp ("we") is an app for tracking pregnancy. This policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for, who we share it with, and what rights you have over it.

applicableLaw.heading: Applicable law
applicableLaw.body: This policy is written to align with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which applies if you use the app from an EU country, and with Law No. 787, Nicaragua's Personal Data Protection Law, the country where the data controller is based. Since the app is also available in the United States through Google Play, section 9 of this policy adds the further disclosures required by Washington State's My Health My Data Act for consumer health data.

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
body: GestandoApp is operated by Juan Ramón Junior Romero Cano, as an individual, based in Managua, Nicaragua, who is the controller of your personal data.
For any privacy question, you can reach us at contact@jromeroc.dev.

dataCollected.heading: 2. What data we collect
dataCollected.intro: We collect the data you enter directly into the app:

categories.title: Account
items: Email and password (your password is stored encrypted, never in plain text)
First name, last name, height, and pre-pregnancy weight

categories.title: Pregnancy
items: Last menstrual period, due date, baby's name, notes, medical conditions (e.g. anemia, gestational diabetes, hypertension), your doctor and clinic's details

categories.title: Appointments
items: Date, location, and provider for each appointment
Vitals you log: blood pressure, uterine height, fetal heart rate, estimated baby weight
Reports or results you upload

categories.title: Diary
items: Mood, symptoms, weight, baby movements, sleep hours
Photos and voice notes you add
Free-text notes you write

categories.title: Progress
items: Pregnancy progress photos, weight, and belly circumference by week

dataCollected.note: This is health data. We treat it as a special category of data and only process it with your explicit consent.

purpose.heading: 3. What we use your data for
items: To provide the service: showing your progress, appointments, and journal
To send you the reminders you set up yourself (appointments, weigh-ins, journal notes)
To provide support when you contact us
To improve the app in aggregate, anonymized form
purpose.legalBasis: The legal basis for processing your health data is your explicit consent, given when you create your account through a dedicated health-data checkbox, separate from accepting this policy in general. You can withdraw that consent at any time without deleting your account: doing so erases your pregnancy, appointments, exams, journal, and progress photos, but your account and login stay active. You can do this yourself from Profile → Danger zone → "Withdraw health data consent", or by emailing us at contact@jromeroc.dev. If you'd rather, you can also delete your account entirely — see "Your rights" below.

sharing.heading: 4. Who we share your data with
body: We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.

We use Supabase (database and file storage) as a data processor to run the app. Your data is hosted in the US East (Ohio) region. Supabase incorporates the EU Standard Contractual Clauses into its Data Processing Addendum (DPA) to cover this international data transfer if you're a user in the European Union. This DPA is part of Supabase's standard Terms of Service, so it applies automatically to our account with no separate acceptance step.
We may share data if required to by law.

retention.heading: 5. How long we keep your data
retention.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we delete your personal data within a reasonable period, unless the law requires us to retain some information for longer.

rights.heading: 6. Your rights
rights.intro: Regardless of which country you use the app from, you have the right to:
items: Access the data we hold about you
Correct inaccurate or incomplete data (rectification)
Ask us to delete your account and your data ("right to be forgotten" / cancellation)
Request a copy of your data in a portable format
Object to processing or withdraw your consent at any time
Lodge a complaint with your country's data protection authority
rights.note: These rights match those granted by the GDPR to users in the European Union, and the access, rectification, cancellation, and objection rights under Nicaragua's Law No. 787.
rights.how: You can delete your own account at any time from Profile → Danger zone in the app, or exercise any of these rights by writing to us at contact@jromeroc.dev.
rights.deleteAccountHeading: How to delete your GestandoApp account
rights.deleteAccountSteps: If you have the app installed: open GestandoApp → Profile → Danger zone → "Delete my account", and enter your password to confirm. If you don't have access to the app, or would rather request it another way, email us at contact@jromeroc.dev with your account's email address and a request to delete it — we'll delete it ourselves within a reasonable time.
rights.deleteAccountData: Deleting your account erases: your profile (name, height, weight), your pregnancy profile, your appointments and exams, your journal (notes, photos, and voice recordings), and your progress photos. This happens within a reasonable time after the request, unless the law requires us to keep some information longer (see "How long we keep your data" above).

security.heading: 7. Security
security.body: We apply reasonable technical measures to protect your data, such as password encryption and secure connections (HTTPS). No app is 100% secure, but we're committed to improving these measures over time.

children.heading: 8. Children
children.body: GestandoApp is meant for people 18 and older. We don't knowingly collect data from anyone younger than that. If we learn that an account belongs to someone under 18, we'll delete that account and all associated health data.

usHealthData.heading: 9. Consumer health data (Washington, USA)
usHealthData.intro: If you use GestandoApp from Washington State, USA, this section gives you additional information required by that state's My Health My Data Act (MHMDA) about the "consumer health data" we collect.
usHealthData.categoriesHeading: Categories of consumer health data we collect
categories: Pregnancy status and estimated due date
Menstrual and reproductive information (last menstrual period date)
Medical conditions you record (e.g. anemia, gestational diabetes, hypertension)
Vitals: blood pressure, uterine height, fetal heart rate, estimated baby weight
Mood, symptoms, weight, and baby movements you log in the journal
Photos and voice notes you upload, and text you write in the journal
usHealthData.sources: You enter all of this data directly into the app yourself. We don't collect consumer health data through cookies, advertising trackers, or purchase it from data brokers of any kind.
usHealthData.sharingHeading: Who we share this data with
thirdParties: Supabase (database and file hosting), as a data processor, solely to operate the app.

Expo's push notification service and, through it, Apple and Google: when you turn on appointment/exam reminders, the title you wrote (e.g. "Monthly checkup") travels as the push notification's content so it can be delivered to your device. Neither of them retains that content permanently, they just relay it.
usHealthData.noSaleNoAds: We do not sell your consumer health data, and we do not share it for targeted advertising.
usHealthData.consentCollection: When you create your account, we ask for an explicit, separate consent (distinct from accepting this privacy policy) specifically for processing your health data, through its own checkbox on the sign-up form.
usHealthData.consentSharing: Today we don't share your consumer health data with any third party beyond what's needed to run the service (see above). If we ever wanted to share it with any other third party, we'd ask for your explicit, additional consent before doing so.
usHealthData.noGeofencing: GestandoApp does not use geolocation or geofencing (drawing a boundary around a physical location) around healthcare facilities or any other place.
usHealthData.deletionRights: You can request deletion of your consumer health data at any time (see "Withdraw your health data consent" in section 3). That deletion right extends to Supabase and any other processor the app uses, not just our own systems.

changes.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we make material changes to this policy, we'll notify you in the app before they take effect.
